settings.heading: Ingredients
settings.content:
FreshWipes Ingredients

EDI purified water – base solution

• Glycerin – moisturizes

• Citric acid – balances pH

• Sodium benzoate – gently preserves

• Cetylpyridinium chloride – antibacterial effect

• Tea polyphenols – fresh breath

• Allantoin – soothing

• Green tea extract – naturally antibacterial & protective

Eyewipes Ingredients

EDI-purified water– base solution

Aloe Vera (Aloe Barbadensis)– soothes and moisturizes the skin around the eyes

Chamomile (Chamomilla Recutita)– known for its mild, anti-inflammatory properties

Glycerin– binds moisture and protects the skin

Ethylhexylglycerin– gentle preservation and antibacterial effect

Decyl Glucoside– mild cleansing surfactant from plants

Polyhexamethylene Biguanide Hydrochloride– antibacterial, counteracts irritation

Earwipes ingredienser

N-(3-aminopropyl)-N-dodecyl-1 - gently cleans and helps dissolve dirt and wax


Benzalkonium chloride – antibacterial ingredient that fights bacteria and contributes to healthy ears


Iodopropynyl butylcarbamate – mild preservative component that keeps the wipes hygienic

Corn extract – naturally emollient and nourishing for sensitive skin

Ethylene Glycol Mono Phenyl Ether – helps to gently dissolve grease and impurities

Rosemary extract – naturally cleansing and refreshing, with calming properties

Witch Hazel extract – soothes the skin and reduces irritation

Fragrance – provides a mild, fresh feeling

Water (Aqua) – basic solution


Vitamin E – strengthens and protects sensitive skin

All products are:

✔️ pH-balanced & fragrance-free

✔️ Cruelty-free

✔️ Free from alcohol, fluoride & harsh chemicals

settings.heading: How often should I use the FreshCare Kit?
settings.row_content: Daily use provides the best results. 2 minutes a day is enough to prevent plaque, wax and irritation. You can use all three wipes at the same time or rotate depending on your needs.

settings.heading: Does it work on cats too?
settings.row_content: Yes, the FreshCare Kit is safe for both dogs and cats. The same finger method works equally well.

settings.heading: Are the wipes safe for sensitive skin?
settings.row_content: Yes, all wipes are pH balanced, hypoallergenic and free of alcohol, fluoride and harsh chemicals. Tested by veterinarians.

settings.heading: How long does a kit last?
settings.row_content: With daily use, FreshWipes and EarWipes will last about 1.5-2 months, EyeWipes about 3 months. Total of 200 wipes.

settings.heading: Can I use them if my dog ​​already has dental problems/ear infections?
settings.row_content: FreshCare Kit is primarily preventative. If your dog already has serious problems, consult a veterinarian first. The wipes can be used as daily maintenance care after treatment.

settings.heading: What do I do if my dog ​​won't stay still?
settings.row_content: The finger method feels natural to dogs - like scratching behind the ear. Start calmly, reward with treats afterwards, and make it a positive routine. Most dogs will accept it within a few days.

settings.heading: Can I just buy FreshWipes separately?
settings.row_content: Yes, all products are available to purchase separately. However, the kit provides the best value and complete care for 500 SEK less than buying all three separately.
